title: FloodGuard Waiting Period and Renewal Grace Schedule
content:
FloodGuard Private Flood Policy timing values by tier. All periods are in calendar days except the map revision window, which is in calendar months.

| Tier | Voluntary purchase (days) | Purchase tied to a loan (days) | Map revision purchase (days) | Map revision window (months) | Voluntary midterm limit increase (days) | Renewal grace period (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | 30 | 0 | 1 | 13 | 30 | 30 |
| FloodGuard Essential | 14 | 0 | 1 | 13 | 14 | 30 |
| FloodGuard Standard | 14 | 0 | 1 | 13 | 14 | 30 |
| FloodGuard Plus | 14 | 0 | 1 | 13 | 14 | 30 |
| FloodGuard Premier | 10 | 0 | 1 | 13 | 10 | 30 |
| FloodGuard High Value | 10 | 0 | 1 | 13 | 10 | 30 |

**What each column is.**

- *Voluntary purchase* — the waiting period between application and coverage for a voluntary purchase.
- *Purchase tied to a loan* — the waiting period when the purchase is tied to making, increasing, extending or renewing a loan.
- *Map revision purchase* — the waiting period when the policy is bought within the map revision window after a flood map revision placed the building in a high-risk zone.
- *Map revision window* — the months after a map revision during which the map revision waiting period applies.
- *Voluntary midterm limit increase* — the waiting period before a voluntary midterm coverage increase attaches.
- *Renewal grace period* — the days after expiration within which the renewal premium keeps coverage continuous.

**Tier comparisons (derived from the table).** A voluntary purchase waits 30 days on FloodGuard Contents Only, 14 days on FloodGuard Essential, Standard and Plus, and 10 days on FloodGuard Premier and High Value; the voluntary midterm limit increase period equals the voluntary purchase period on every tier. The loan-tied period (0 days), the map revision period (1 day), the map revision window (13 months) and the renewal grace period (30 days) are the same on all six tiers.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A voluntary FloodGuard Premier application bound on 1 April has an effective date of 11 April, ten calendar days later; the same application on FloodGuard Contents Only has an effective date of 1 May, thirty calendar days later.
